providerConfiguration.title: Provider groups and configuration
providerConfiguration.description: Organize account connections, review inherited settings, and exchange configuration without credentials. Agent installation and login are managed separately.
providerConfiguration.enabled: Enable this connection for new requests
providerConfiguration.anonymous: This HTTP service requires no authentication
providerConfiguration.pendingActivation: Configuration was saved, but the runtime could not apply it. Reload to inspect the active version.
providerConfiguration.clientPolicyHint: Choose the public routes and upstream connections this key may use. A later route expansion does not automatically grant new connections.
providerConfiguration.clientEnabled: Allow new requests with this key
providerConfiguration.legacyPolicy: This existing key retains its previous unrestricted scope. Selecting routes narrows it.
providerConfiguration.approveRouteConnections: Approve the current connections of the selected routes
providerConfiguration.keyModel: New keys are limited to {{model}} and its currently approved connections.
providerConfiguration.limitAccount: Limit concurrent text model requests for this account
providerConfiguration.budgetEnabled: Track and manage this key’s budget
providerConfiguration.budgetHint: Hard budgets reserve the declared model context ceiling plus maximum output and reject requests without a conservative bound. Retries also reserve tokens; unknown usage stays reserved. Period and time-zone changes take effect after the open window.
providerConfiguration.secretSlots: After import, configure {{count}} credential/header slots in the account settings. Local keys are not copied.
providerConfiguration.dryRunHint: Checks saved configuration and current health without sending a model request or consuming inference tokens.

reason.route_guarantee: Request exceeds the guaranteed capability intersection

providerConfiguration.explicitEndpoint: Set endpoint mode and wire protocol for this account
providerConfiguration.credentialHosts: Credential-approved discovery hosts (comma-separated; include non-default port)
providerConfiguration.manualModels: Manual model IDs (one per line, retained after catalog refresh)
providerConfiguration.catalogObserved: {{time}} · Source {{source}}. Discovery does not verify actual inference.
providerConfiguration.catalogStale: Historical catalog from {{time}}; expired or the latest refresh failed.
providerConfiguration.catalogDifferentAccount: This observation from {{time}} belongs to an older account or endpoint. Refresh this connection.
providerConfiguration.catalogUnknown: No catalog observation for this connection yet.
providerConfiguration.catalogFailed: Catalog refresh failed. Check this connection’s credentials and discovery endpoint.
providerConfiguration.searchModels: Search discovered, selected and manual models
providerConfiguration.inputTokenUpperBound: Hard-budget input token ceiling (must cover every model’s input window; blank rejects hard-budget requests)
providerConfiguration.templateHint: Template updates preserve credentials and explicit overrides. Account copies contain configuration only and start paused; configure their credentials separately.
providerConfiguration.resetTemplateEndpoint: Reset endpoint fields to template/group inheritance
providerConfiguration.inferenceTestHint: This separate test sends a short inference request for the first selected model and may incur provider charges. Catalog refresh never runs inference.
providerConfiguration.inferenceTest: Run real inference test (may incur charges)
providerConfiguration.costAlertHint: Estimate only; this never blocks requests or promises a monetary spending ceiling. Missing prices or usage remain unknown. The active window survives restarts; period and time-zone changes apply after it closes.
providerConfiguration.costEstimate: Reference estimate ${{usd}} / ${{limitUsd}} · {{unknownAttempts}} attempts with unknown cost
providerConfiguration.capabilityGuaranteed: Guarantee every eligible account supports the request
providerConfiguration.retryHealthHint: Permit bounded recovery on the next request. This action sends no inference request.
providerConfiguration.inferenceDisclosure: The real test sends “Reply with OK.” to the selected route and may incur provider charges.
providerConfiguration.nativeScopeHint: This connection manages inference and login through its native adapter. Only quota permissions can be configured here.
providerConfiguration.costLimitEnforce: Refuse requests once the estimate reaches this amount

providerExchange.title: Configuration exchange and protected recovery
providerExchange.description: Ordinary exports contain configuration and secret slots only. A password encrypted backup is a separate, explicit action.
providerExchange.backupReady: Encrypted backup created. {{count}} credential slots were unavailable and remain drafts.
providerExchange.remapExplanation: Conflicting identities are remapped. Imported accounts are new accounts; existing credentials and policies remain unchanged.
providerExchange.headerJson: Header JSON with exactly the displayed names
providerExchange.drafts: Blank slots create unconfigured drafts. No secret is written until you apply this reviewed import.
providerExchange.recoveryAllowed: Current configuration can be represented by schema v1.
providerExchange.recoveryBlocked: Downgrade is blocked because schema v1 cannot preserve the listed settings.
providerExchange.recoveryInstructions: Recovery export preserves current account identities and protected references. Stop all Kun runtimes and the Manager before replacing a Registry file; retain the v2 file and credential store as recovery backups. This action does not activate an old backup or overwrite history.
providerExchange.recoveryExport: Export current schema v1 recovery document
providerExchange.existingAccount: Bind an existing local account (matching host and adapter only)

providerRemoval.title: Remove account connection
providerRemoval.impact: Affected Registry references: {{routes}} routes and {{clients}} client policies.
providerRemoval.externalReferences: Bindings in roles, ADE, scheduled tasks and projects must be changed in their own settings first. Historical identities are preserved.
providerRemoval.clearRegistryReferences: Explicitly clear this connection’s default, route, failover and client scope references in the reviewed transaction

providerStaleModels.title: Models this provider no longer lists
providerStaleModels.description: The provider's latest model list leaves these out, but Kun still uses them. Requests to them will likely fail. Models you added by hand are never listed here.
providerStaleModels.default: still the default model; change it in the default model setting
providerStaleModels.keptRoutes: {{names}} would have no members left, so they keep theirs; edit those routes on the Routing page.
